svg.title: 09 — RAG Physical Architecture - Stage 2: Integration Testing

g.text: 09 — RAG Physical Architecture - Stage 2: Integration Testing
Local models load through one global FIFO queue.
Calls to the same model instance are serialized.
Different loaded models may run concurrently.
Qwen weights are hosted by SiliconFlow.
Hardware-aware admission control is deferred to v1.0.0.
Real servers, real models, real data.
